# SheetJS Community Edition

Version 0.20.3, distributed under the included Apache 2.0 LICENSE.

Official source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

This standalone build is bundled locally so employee spreadsheet imports do not
require internet access. Both upload pages and the import tests use this file.
When upgrading, replace the script and license from the official distribution,
update the versioned HTML references and test assertion, and run the frontend tests.
